notes.title: The game is released!
notes.notes:
We are happy to present the game "Starlight Riddles". Explore a mysterious city, as well as an underground maze and find a way out of this trap.

Despite the fact that this is our first game and it may have some shortcomings, we tried to make it interesting. But if you have any suggestions for improving the game, we will be happy to hear them.

I would like to thank everyone who supported us during the development process. For me, this is more than a game and I hope "Starlight Riddles" will find a response in your hearts too 💖

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.10
notes.notes:
We are diligently preparing for the release and in this update we have added:

🏅 Steam Achievements
💬 Improved hints for interacting with some interactive objects
✨ Improved the interface
🛠️ Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.6
notes.notes:
The release is coming and we continue to work on improving the game. Here is a list of improvements in this update:

⚔️ Added the ability to destroy Dark Entities in the Abandoned Zone
💖 Added a new item "Nice Memories"
🔨 Added a new recipe for crafting in the workshop
✅ Added 1 more optional quest
🎻 Written 1 more soundtrack
🛠️ Many small fixes and improvements

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.5 - Pre-release update ✨
notes.notes:
[b]We are working hard on the release, trying to make the gameplay as convenient as possible and here is the list of changes:[/b]

🗺️ A map for the central location has been added
💬 Added hints for items that can be used
🤩 Minor interface improvements
🔑 Added a small hint for completing one of the quests in the maze
🎮 Added more interactive objects

We can't wait to show the game! We hope everyone will find something of their own in it 💖

notes.title: Starlight Riddles will be released on November 1!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Starlight Riddles will be released on November 1! We have put a lot of time and effort into the game and can't wait to show it to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912747/9c10d15de594f0795cfd512bd310b6f8e4065603.gif[/img]

In Starlight Riddles, you will unravel the mystery of a mysterious city where you find yourself with no memories of the past. Can you leave this place and is it even possible?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912747/8629231e4cf2ef8cffc6fc3f42e3c516d805faaa.gif[/img]

[h2]What have we prepared for you?[/h2]

🔎 Explore the mysterious city: examine every corner of the locations in search of answers to your questions.
👨‍🔬 Help the scientist: collect all the parts for the antenna to receive a mysterious signal from space.
🛠️ Crafting: use the resources you find to create parts and other useful tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912747/957f1d6b8691dd86691f63cdb4f4f832922c4788.gif[/img]

👽 Maze and battles: navigate through the mazes under the city, encountering enemies or finding ways to bypass them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912747/f339673b7b9fd36144e9cebc26fb9e5538739c06.gif[/img]

💬 Interact with characters: talk to the townspeople to learn their stories and get hints.
🤨 Quests: Complete interesting tasks that will bring you closer to the solution... or not ;)
🏭 Build an entire factory to create the necessary parts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912747/c7335ed08a0414058277804cc67203a703ce1ae7.gif[/img]

🚀 Travel to space: collect signals and get various items for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912747/66aa22c08cdf4e0b0b833d4d376906f131116c5c.gif[/img]

🎧 Atmospheric soundtracks: more than 10 original atmospheric soundtracks written for complete immersion in the mysterious city.
